BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar gathers the princes and rulers of his provinces to the dedication of the image.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the potentates of Babylon gathered to bow, and the three who would not bow are the ones I remember.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
